title: Google Meet & Chat Enterprise Collaboration Design & Configuration
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Configure Meet and Chat for secure, well-governed collaboration
problem: Meet and Chat rolled out on defaults leave meeting-safety, external-access, and space-governance gaps. This solution designs the Meet & Chat collaboration model: Meet safety and host controls, recording/transcription and storage policy, external participant rules, Chat spaces architecture, external chat and file-sharing policy, history/retention, and app/bot governance — so real-time collaboration is productive and controlled.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Meet + Chat model: meeting safety/host controls, recording/storage, external access, Chat spaces + governance, history/retention, and bot/app policy.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + super-admin, groups/OUs, retention/compliance policy, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — configure Meet safety/host + recording policy, set external participant rules, design Chat spaces + external/file policy, set history/retention, and govern apps/bots — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (controls enforced by OU/group, external access scoped, retention applied) plus Best Practices for scaling collaboration governance.
short: Design and configure Google Meet & Chat for the enterprise — meeting safety/host controls, recording/retention, external-access rules, Chat spaces architecture, and app/bot governance — so real-time collaboration is productive and controlled. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
